description:
Projected resident population of every New South Wales council area, 2021 to 2041, every year, with five age bands. **Modelled estimates.**

Coverage: NSW: 129 council areas; every year 2021-2041 (figures at 30 June). Current to 2041-06-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/population-projections-nsw`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_population, aged_0_14, aged_15_24, aged_25_44, aged_45_64, aged_65_plus. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: lga_demographics_population_projections_nsw
title: LGA · Population projections (NSW)
